title: Account sprint notes: renewal push + support triage (daily)
body:
Quick context: running a 3-day renewal sprint for a few mid-market accounts that are on the fence. Parallel triage for an embedding regression impacting 2 customers. This is my working list for today — very much a scratchpad, will refine into a formal playbook if things consolidate.

MORNING BLOCK (8:00–11:30)
- 08:15 — triage stand with Diego (15m): alignment on JIRA-3241 reproduce steps and temporary mitigation. Goal: confirm whether regression is model-serving or client prompt change.
- 09:00 — call prep for Nimbus Health renewal (ACV ~$120k). Owner: me. Goals: confirm executive sponsor, negotiate final SSO clause, verify usage baseline from billing.
- 10:00 — quick email to Solutions Eng to request a deep-dive for ticket JIRA-3302 (priority: high). Include logs, recent deploy hashes, and sample payloads.

TODAY PRIORITIES (top of mind)
1) Nimbus Health — win renewal this week. Prep checklist: updated SOW (Anna), legal redline accepted? (Maya to confirm), two pager ROI snapshot (use analytics export), exec briefing slide (1 slide + notes).
2) Drift Labs — follow-up on demo feedback. They flagged latency for long prompts. Ask infra for latency tail report last 30 days.
3) Embedding regression — triage, hotfix if serving-side. Communicate clear ETA to affected customers.

ACTION ITEMS (concrete)
- [ ] Draft Nimbus email to CEO + CTO with usage summary + proposed terms (target send: 2026-04-11 13:00).
- [ ] Create shared sandbox for Drift Labs repro and invite SEs (Diego).
- [ ] Attach token-cost breakdown to renewal SOW — show expected monthly cost at current usage and with 10% growth (Anna to generate numbers).
- [ ] Escalate JIRA-3241 to on-call infra if reproduce on latest canary (tag: infra-oncall).
- [ ] Prep fallback messaging for customers impacted by embeddings regression (short template below).

NOTES TO SELF / TACTICAL WORDING
- Nimbus email subject: "Nimbus health — recommended renewal terms + impact summary". Keep subject concise; include our ROI line in first paragraph.
- Opening sentence for execs: "Wanted to share a short summary of production impact and recommended next steps to keep <team> running smoothly." 
- If legal pushes SSO clause delay: propose a 30-day limited extension with proof-of-compliance milestones.

TEMPLATE: outage / regression notice (short)
"Hi <Name>,

Quick note: we identified an issue affecting embedding similarity scores for a subset of requests starting on <date>. Our engineering team is actively investigating; we will share a remediation ETA within 4 business hours and an interim workaround in the next update. Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts search/relevance flows and are treating it as high priority.

Best,
Maya
"

STAKEHOLDER MAP (Nimbus)
- Sponsor: Dr. Lena Brooks (VP Data) — needs ROI and security assurances.
- Procurement: Tom Hale — procurement timeline: 2–3 business days after legal sign-off.
- Eng champion: Priya Sharma — will validate integration tests.

RISKS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Legal redline timeline: who owns follow-up if in transit? (Action: Anna to nudge legal).
- Latency concern for Drift Labs — is it model variant selection or routing policy? Need infra report.
- If embeddings hotfix requires model rollback, what is rollback window and client-facing impact? Confirm with Release Eng.

MEETING NOTES (short snippets)
- 2026-04-10 sync w/ Anna: she will add token-cost appendix to SOW and draft the exec slide.
- Diego: reproduction steps for JIRA-3241 include sending full request headers; he suspects a tokenization edge case on the client.

FOLLOW-UPS (who to ping)
- Ping @anna.kim in #cs-renewals for SOW draft (target: EOD).
- DM @diego.torres for sandbox link and repro artifacts.
- Add @sre-oncall if embargoed hotfix needed.

RANDOM THOUGHTS / BRAIN DUMP (keep short)
- Might be worth proposing a short trial pricing tier for Nimbus: 1-month "stability" discount if they commit to 12 months.
- Consider adding a small paragraph in renewal about our fallback/canary policy to reassure infra teams.

END OF SPRINT NOTE: once Nimbus confirmed or pushed, convert this doc -> formal renewal playbook and move to confluence under cs/renewals/
summary: Working scratchpad for a focused renewal + support triage day. Contains schedule, action items, email templates, stakeholder map and escalation notes.
